उर्द् उर्द्, cl. 1. A. ऊर्दते, ऊर्दाञ्-चक्रे,
ऊर्दिष्यते, और्दिष्ट, ऊर्दितुम्, to mea-
sure; to play; to be easy or cheerful.

ऊर्द् ऊर्द्, a various reading for rt. उर्द्,
q. v.
उर्द्र उर्द्र, अस्, m. an otter. See उद्र.

ऊर्दर ऊर्दर, अस्, m. (said to be in some of
its meanings fr. ऊर्ज् and rt. दॄ), Ved. a vessel for
measuring corn, a bushel; a hero, a champion; a
Rakṣas, a goblin or fiend.
